name: Gokshuradi Churna

sections.overview: Gokshuradi Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage
sections.introduction: Gokshuradi Churna is an herbal formulation in the form of powder. It is helpful in treating urinary disorders and inflammation. It helps in calming Vata and Kapha doshas.
sections.ingredients:
Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Shunthi and Ardraka (Zingiber officinalis) (wet and dry ginger) 
 Punarnava (Boerhaavia diffusa) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Garlic (Allium sativum) 

 Method of Preparation 
 Clean, dry and grind all the ingredients separately to obtain a fine powder. After that, mix all the herbal powders till homogenous and store it in a clean and dry bottle away from heat and moisture.
sections.dosage: 1 to 2 grams along with honey twice daily after meals or as prescribed by your physician.
sections.indications:
Anti-inflammatory properties 
 Diuretic 
 Bloating 
 Ascites 
 Urinary disorders
sections.contraindications:
There are no reported side effects with this medicine. 

 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.

fullContent:
Gokshuradi Churna – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Introduction 
 Gokshuradi Churna is an herbal formulation in the form of powder. It is helpful in treating urinary disorders and inflammation. It helps in calming Vata and Kapha doshas. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Gokshura (Tribulus terrestris) 
 Shunthi and Ardraka (Zingiber officinalis) (wet and dry ginger) 
 Punarnava (Boerhaavia diffusa) 
 Haritaki (Terminalia chebula) 
 Devadaru (Cedrus deodara) 
 Garlic (Allium sativum) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Clean, dry and grind all the ingredients separately to obtain a fine powder. After that, mix all the herbal powders till homogenous and store it in a clean and dry bottle away from heat and moisture. 
 Dosage 
 1 to 2 grams along with honey twice daily after meals or as prescribed by your physician. 
 Indications 
 
 Anti-inflammatory properties 
 Diuretic 
 Bloating 
 Ascites 
 Urinary disorders 
 
 Contraindications 
 There are no reported side effects with this medicine. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
